mapper.select: SELECT p.pln_id, p.m_id, p.pln_title, TO_CHAR(p.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as start_date, TO_CHAR(p.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as end_date, p.total_days, p.is_public, p.share_link, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as created_at, TO_CHAR(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updated_at, NULL as ldong_regn_cd, NULL as ldong_signgu_cd, m.m_nickname, '' AS region_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id) AS favorite_count, d.day_id, d.day_number, TO_CHAR(d.trip_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as trip_date, d.memo AS day_memo, pp.place_id, pp.contentid, pp.sort_order AS place_order, tc.title AS place_title, tc.addr1, tc.firstimage, tc.contenttypeid, tc.mapx, tc.mapy FROM planner p JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id LEFT JOIN planner_day d ON p.pln_id = d.pln_id LEFT JOIN planner_place pp ON d.day_id = pp.day_id LEFT JOIN destination tc ON pp.contentid = tc.contentid WHERE p.pln_id = #{plnId} ORDER BY d.day_number ASC, pp.sort_order ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.* FROM ( SELECT p.pln_id AS plnId, p.m_id AS mId, m.m_nickname AS authorNickname, p.pln_title AS plnTitle, TO_CHAR(p.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(p.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, p.total_days AS totalDays, '' AS regionName, p.is_public AS isPublic,
-- ⚠️ [수정] TO_CHAR 제거! (DTO가 Timestamp면 원본 컬럼 써야 함) p.created_at AS createdAt,
-- 썸네일 서브쿼리 (이전 수정 유지) (SELECT d.firstimage FROM planner_place pp JOIN destination d ON pp.contentid = d.contentid JOIN planner_day pd ON pp.day_id = pd.day_id WHERE pd.pln_id = p.pln_id AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnailImage,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite_planner WHERE pln_id = p.pln_id) AS favoriteCount FROM planner p JOIN member m ON p.m_id = m.m_id WHERE p.m_id = #{mId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{offset} + #{size}) ) WHERE rnum >= (#{offset} + 1)
